manifest.name: Extensions
manifest.description: Lists every plugin with its version, source and status; administrators enable or disable plugins for everyone.

sidebar.catalogFailed: Plugin status could not be loaded from the server, so availability is not checked: {{error}}

toggle.loadFailed: {{name}} is enabled, but its script could not be loaded.

detail.unknown: There is no plugin with the id "{{id}}".
detail.coreHint: Part of the workbench itself; it cannot be disabled.
detail.adminOnly: Only administrators can enable or disable plugins.

disableConfirm.title: Disable {{name}}?
disableConfirm.message: {{name}} is turned off for every user: its views, commands and actions disappear until an administrator enables it again.

detail.backendMissing: This server does not have it.
detail.conflictHint: An external plugin in the plugins directory uses this id ({{entry}}). It is never loaded: give it an id of its own, in its manifest and its directory name.

contributes.notLoaded: The plugin's script is not loaded in this window, so its contributions are not known yet. Enable it to load it.
contributes.serverOnly: This plugin runs on the server and has no views of its own in this version.
contributes.nothing: This plugin adds nothing to the user interface.
